text:
lucas (sales): heads-up — during the ACME live demo at 10:12am PST we started getting 429s and the demo stalled. customer is on trial credits.

emma (solutions): oh no. which endpoint and model? any x-request-id or headers to share?

lucas (sales): calling /v1/generate?model=redwood-3b, max_tokens=4096, multiple concurrent streams. sample response header: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000/min`, request id `req_8f7a12`.

ali (backend): can you paste a raw response or log line? helps determine if it's per-route cap or global token budget.

lucas (sales): paste from the SDK log: ```
2026-03-20T17:12:05Z ERROR generation failed request_id=req_8f7a12 status=429 message="Rate limit exceeded" route=/v1/generate tenant=acct-ACME tokens=118560 window=60s
```

olivia (eng-oncall): that tokens=118560 in 60s looks like token burst > burst window. are they sending many parallel requests or huge prompts?

lucas (sales): demo script spawns 6 parallel sessions, each ~20k tokens in a minute (system+user) while iterating a long few-shot prompt.

emma (solutions): this sounds like per-tenant token_budget + per-route burst cap. trial tenants have conservative burst of 50k tokens/min. quota-bot, can you show current tenant counters?

quota-bot: Current counters for acct-ACME:
- route:/v1/generate window:60s used=118560 limit=100000 burst=50000
- global token_budget daily used=278k limit=300k

ali (backend): confirms per-route config triggered. two levers: temporary burst increase or fallback to smaller model. ops can do a 10m bump.

olivia (eng-oncall): run this admin check locally and paste output: `rb-admin ratecheck --tenant=acct-ACME --route=/v1/generate --window=60s`

lucas (sales): ran it, output: ```
route:/v1/generate window=60s
used=118560
limit=100000
burst_limit=50000
last_reset=2026-03-20T17:11:00Z
```

olivia (eng-oncall): ok. I'll apply a temporary policy: increase burst_limit -> 200000 for 10 minutes and enable auto-fallback to redwood-1b for requests tagged `demo` so we protect the tenant daily budget. doing now, will post once applied.

emma (solutions): also recommend immediate workaround for the demo: reduce max_tokens to 1024 and stream responses so they don't accumulate in a single request. tell ACME to pause the concurrent sessions to two during the remainder.

olivia (eng-oncall): change applied at 17:14:03Z. policy id: policy-eb3f. note: this will still count toward global daily budget — recommend billing team to approve a short trial quota top-up.

lucas (sales): thanks — resuming demo. can we get a temporary daily cap increase? customer expects multi-hour run tomorrow.

emma (solutions): I'll open a billing assist request and tag @billing for a 24h top-up of +500k tokens to acct-ACME. link will be in CRM.

ali (backend): follow-up: we should add an alert for trial tenants doing >80% of daily token budget within 30m so sales can be warned proactively. filing a ticket.

lucas (sales): appreciated. demo resumed and the customer continued. will capture the script changes and share. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
